puzzle.title: Тікети Puzzle
puzzle.pageDescription: Усі синхронізовані тікети з Puzzel CM для reception
puzzle.bucketHint: Under All statuses (filter) you only see status values for the current view — Active or Resolved each show a subset. Choose All tickets for the full list. Resolved/Closed appear under Resolved. After sending a reply via PrizeBern the status is set to Resolved as in Puzzel.
puzzle.categoryBreakdownHint: Count per PrizeBern category (spam, invoice requested, …) based on stored AI analysis.
puzzle.filterHint: Values used by sync in Puzzel before reading the ticket list.
puzzle.emptyTickets: No tickets yet. Once an admin has entered email, password and 2FA seed under Puzzle → Credentials, the server fetches the list automatically about every 15 minutes (disable: env PUZZEL_AUTO_SYNC=false). Admins can also trigger Sync now.
puzzle.noFilterMatch: No tickets match the current filters.
puzzle.missingReplyHint: Stored AI analysis without guest reply. In the AI overview choose Re-analyze (or reopen the ticket) to generate a suggestion.
puzzle.replyHint: Reply and attachments are sent through Puzzel (same as the pink Send in the CM composer).
puzzle.replyPlaceholder: Write a reply to the guest…
puzzle.signatureHint: Use the same signature/business data you want in Puzzel.
puzzle.archiveNoReply: Archive: tickets with status Resolved or Closed in Puzzel. No new replies can be sent here.
puzzle.ticketClosedNoReply: This ticket is done — replies via PrizeBern are disabled.
puzzle.selectTicketHint: The chat history and actions will appear here.
puzzle.suggestedReplyHint: Draft for the guest — please review. If the AI mentions an invoice attachment, attach the PDF before sending.
puzzle.aiOverviewWaiting: Once messages for this ticket are loaded from Puzzel, AI will summarize the request automatically.
puzzle.aiConfigHint: If no OpenAI API key is configured: Admin → Settings → AI Config.
puzzle.noInvoiceFieldsFlagged: No line-items explicitly flagged as “must appear on invoice” (may still be a company booking — see intent above).

companyBillingIntent.yes: Guest wants company / full billing details on the invoice
